concerns.text: FR-001 requires downloading knot data directly from Knot Atlas, but T011 implements data download via the `database-knotinfo` client wrapper, which does not satisfy the specification’s mandate to source data from Knot Atlas.
FR-004 (scatter‑plot generation of crossing number vs. braid index stratified by alternating classification) is not represented by any task; no task creates or validates the required PNG plots.
FR-006 (computation and reporting of Spearman and Pearson correlation coefficients, plus effect‑size measures) is absent; there is no task that calculates or documents these correlations.
SC-016 (automated validation that scatter‑plot images meet resolution, labeling, and visibility criteria) is missing; no task runs a plot‑validator or produces `plot_validation_report.md`.
